title: Could have been better
text: Could have been better. This would have possibly gotten a better review but considering the first time the "package" was sent out there was nothing but and empty envelope which is unacceptable whether it was on the companies end or amazons. But that aside after I issued a replacement it actually arrived in one piece it  does come as described it is bit of a rough cut but besides that it is good
